set.description: 完成一件事有若干类办法，类与类互斥，总办法数等于各类办法数相加。
set.name: Addition Principle of Counting

criteria: 能计算排列数
能说出排列数公式的含义
set.description: 排列数 A(n,k)=n!/(n−k)!，也就是从 n 起连乘 k 个递减的正整数。
set.name: Formula for the number of permutations

criteria: 能说出排列与顺序有关
能计算很小的排列个数
set.description: 从 n 个不同元素中取出 k 个排成一列，顺序不同算不同的排列。
set.name: Concept of permutations

criteria: Evaluate a factorial or nested factorial using its actual integer argument, not a power or a repeated exclamation mark rule.
Cancel valid factorial quotients and preserve all argument-domain restrictions.
set.description: For an integer n>=0, n! is the product 1*2*...*n, with 0!=1. Evaluate nested factorials from the inside, and simplify factorial quotients only where all factorial arguments are nonnegative integers.
set.name: Factorial notation and evaluation

set.reason: Contrasting disjoint alternatives with sequential choices helps choose an operation. An array of shirts and trousers establishes the product principle independently of the addition rule.
set.scope: recognizing sequential steps and multiplying

set.reason: Filling positions by multiplication supports permutation counts, while exhaustive ordered-pair listing meets the actual very-small-count and order-sensitivity criteria without multiplying stages.
set.scope: order sensitivity and very small permutation counts

set.reason: Factorial notation helps read n!/(n-k)!, although the existing descending-product form gives a route that avoids factorial notation. The permutation formula has a descending-product representation. Factorial notation prepares the quotient representation without being necessary for the product route.
set.scope: Interpret the factorial quotient in the permutation formula.

set.reason: A(n,k) counts ordered selections. The permutation meaning supplies what the formula is evaluating, without requiring a particular factorial computation on every problem.
set.scope: meaning and computation of A(n,k)

set.reason: Uniform contributions are often totaled by multiplication, which helps. Double counting itself only needs two summations of one set, and either summation can be done by direct addition.
set.scope: product counts of uniform incidence contributions

criteria: 能计算平均数
能说明其含义
set.description: 理解平均数是反映一组数据集中趋势的统计量，会求算术平均数。
set.name: Mean

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分步相乘

set.description: 完成一件事要依次做若干步，每步的办法数相乘就是总办法数。
set.name: Multiplication Principle of Counting

criteria: Define the same counted set in both counts.
Account for contribution multiplicities.
set.description: Count one finite set of objects or incidences in two ways and equate totals, tracking each underlying object contribution.
set.name: Double counting and incidence counts
